description: This file contains unit tests for the HealthcheckService class, which manages health check pings for server sessions. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as ping sending, timeout handling, server removal, and acknowledgment processing.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceTests
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing the HealthcheckService class, providing setup, mock expectations, and helper methods for simulating timer and server events.

methods.name: timerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and starting the periodic healthcheck timer.

methods.name: pingWillBeSent
methods.description: Sets expectation for sending a ping and capturing its ID.

methods.name: errorIndicationWillBeSent
methods.description: Sets expectation for indicating a server error state.

methods.name: createSut
methods.description: Creates the System Under Test (HealthcheckService) with optional custom interval.

methods.name: triggerPingTimeout
methods.description: Simulates the timer callback to trigger a ping send.

methods.name: triggerOnPingSent
methods.description: Simulates the event of a ping being sent with a specific ping ID.

methods.name: triggerOnServerRemoved
methods.description: Simulates the event of server removal.

methods.name: triggerOnAckReceived
methods.description: Simulates receiving an acknowledgment for a ping with success or failure.
